albums.title: 3 AM, Two Cats & An Overdraft
albums.vocals: David Linacre (Male Lead / Phone Spoken / Storytelling)
albums.description: The gritty, hilarious, and deeply soulful reality of independent bedroom music production: an audio interface held together by electrical tape, an overdraft warning on the banking app, and two feline landlords demanding gourmet salmon on the spacebar.

albums.title: Neon Velvet Nights
albums.genre: Uptempo Soul / UK Garage / Neo-Soul Funk
albums.vocals: David Linacre & Maya Chen (Velvet Female Vocals & Crisp Male Rap Duets)
albums.description: High-energy late-night urban groove: snappy 2-step beats, lush Fender Rhodes chords, slapped funk basslines, and velvety male-female vocal duets with dynamic anti-repetitive storytelling.
